claims.statement: Most AI benchmarks skip a zero-model control group that tests what simple lookup already solves.
On bounded math and database tasks, a frozen lookup table matched cloud AI on nine of ten tests.
On open coding tasks AI leaped ahead, while caching verified answers cut repeat energy three point six times.

easy_read.easy_title: A Fair Lookup Baseline for AI
three_points_one_idea_sentences: This study is about a fair lookup baseline for ai.
Most AI benchmarks skip a zero-model control group that tests what simple lookup already solves.
On bounded math and database tasks, a frozen lookup table matched cloud AI on nine of ten tests.
On open coding tasks AI leaped ahead, while caching verified answers cut repeat energy three point six times.
Key result: 9 of 10 Bounded Ties · 3.59x Repeat Energy Cut.
Built-in computer chip counters recorded the energy used.
